question: Why is the crocodile-mounted Gaṅgā honored as foremost among rivers?
premises: Gaṅgā is mounted on a crocodile
She is the best of all rivers
inference: The crocodile-mounted Gaṅgā, best of all rivers, is saluted.
plain_english: I salute Gaṅgā, mounted on a crocodile, the best of all rivers.
